summary: Iteration 9 - Verified all 14 features from review request. Backend (pytest test_iteration9.py): 10 passed / 1 skipped / 0 failed. Frontend (Playwright): all flows green. Key verifications: (1) Login with reCAPTCHA test bypass OK. (2) Dashboard Riepilogo: Inquilini Pagato/Non Pagato/In Ritardo render as <a href="/tenants?status=paid|not_paid|late"> links. (3) GET /api/payment-calendar/{tenant_id} returns {tenant_id, year, calendar:[12 items]} with month 1..12, month_name (Gennaio..Dicembre), status in {paid,not_paid,late,none}, amount, payment_methods[]; returns 404 for invalid id; honors ?year=2025. (4) TenantDetail page renders 12 [data-testid='calendar-month-{n}'] cells under heading 'Calendario Pagamenti {year}'. (5) Tenant form - no 'Professione'/'Occupation' label in the 15 form labels; TenantCreate schema has no occupation field; POST /api/tenants succeeds without it. (6) Tenant list headers = ['Nome','Immobile','Stanza','Deposito','Stato Mese','Azioni'] - no Professione column. (7) Rooms 'Aggiungi Stanza' dialog has property search input (placeholder 'Cerca per nome/indirizzo...'). (8) Rooms 'Assegna Inquilino' dialog has tenant search (placeholder 'Cerca per nome...'). (9) Landlords new form shows 'Scansiona Documento (OCR)' button. (10) Landlords table exposes 5 <input type=file> + 5 lucide-upload icons (one per landlord row). (11) Modal background = rgb(255,251,245) = #FFFBF5 (cream/warm) on property dialog. (12) POST /api/properties without property_code auto-generates code matching ^IMM-[A-Z0-9]{4,}$. Property dialog has NO manual property_code input. (13) POST /api/owner-documents/upload (owner_id, doc_type, file) returns 200 with /uploads/documents/... url and persists in db.documents. (14) Frontend compiles, no console errors captured during the flow. JUnit XML: /app/test_reports/pytest/iteration_9.xml.

minor.issue: Legacy tenant documents in MongoDB still carry an 'occupation' field (removed from TenantCreate schema but not scrubbed from existing docs). API returns raw docs so the field leaks through. Either run a one-time $unset migration (db.tenants.update_many({}, {$unset: {occupation: ''}})) or project it out in the route.

issues: Edit pencil buttons on room rows still lack data-testid='edit-room-{id}' (carried from iter 8).
'Ospitalita' and 'Nazionalita' still missing Italian accent (cosmetic, carried from iter 7/8).

Dialog labels/inputs briefly overlap during the Radix open animation (visible on first frame). Final rendered state is correct - purely a transition artefact; consider disabling slide/fade animation on the DialogContent or giving it a fixed min-height.

useEffect(() => {...}, []) reads searchParams.get('status') but has an empty dependency array, so switching filter via in-app navigation (e.g. Dashboard link click while already on /tenants) keeps the stale tab active until a full refresh (carried from iter 8).

critical_code_review_comments: routes/payment_calendar.py uses string comparison for dates (payment_date: {$gte: 'YYYY-MM-01'}) which is correct only if payment_date is stored as ISO yyyy-mm-dd. If any payment record uses datetime/ObjectId the comparison silently returns no rows. Add a schema check or cast to datetime before comparing.
routes/payment_calendar.py: month_names[] is rebuilt inside the 1..12 loop - lift to module scope.

routes/payment_calendar.py: when a tenant has created_at only (no assignment history), months before creation are marked 'none' but months after creation but before tenant had a room are still marked 'late'. Consider also reading room assignment history / contract start_date.
routes/properties.py generate_property_code retries only 10 times; on exhaustion property_code is left empty (truthy check). Prefer raising 500 or suffixing uuid slice on collision.
routes/tenants.py still returns full documents including legacy 'occupation' key - add projection {occupation: 0} or migrate data.

frontend Landlords.js: owner upload trigger is a <span> wrapped around a hidden <input type=file>. Functional but not semantic; wrap in <label> or <button> for accessibility and easier data-testid targeting.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 passed, 1 intentionally skipped for legacy-data probe)
